description: Public encryption keys for an Opake user. Singleton record (rkey: 'self') published on the user's PDS to enable key discovery for sharing. Carries both an X25519 key and an ML-KEM-768 key for the hybrid post-quantum KEM construction (BSI TR-02102 / ANSSI guidance for hybrid PQ key establishment).

x25519PublicKey.description: Raw X25519 public key bytes (classical half of the hybrid KEM).

x25519Algo.description: Algorithm identifier for the classical encryption key.

mlKemPublicKey.description: Raw ML-KEM-768 public encapsulation key bytes (post-quantum half of the hybrid KEM).

mlKemAlgo.description: Algorithm identifier for the post-quantum encapsulation key.

signingKey.description: Raw Ed25519 signing public key bytes. Used for DID-scoped authentication with the indexer.
